items.rationale: Listener publication/channel creation concurrency remains unresolved in blind holdout review.
items.thread_or_event_queue_model: Stream setup runs on caller thread. VtpStreamSocket creates detached NotifyStreamListener/DoStreamRecv threads and invokes streamReceiver_ under streamSocketLock_. streamListener_ itself is not shown to be read by callbacks; StreamSocketListener keeps a separate listener_ copy.
items.trigger_conditions_and_race_window: Would require product caller to invoke public SetStreamRecvListener concurrently with Create*Channel or another setter. Production call-site search found setup calls and tests only.
